name: Ľudovít Ódor - Projet du Conseil
title: REPORT on the draft Council directive amending Directive 2006/112/EC as regards VAT rules relating to taxable persons who facilitate distance sales of imported goods and the application of the special scheme for distance sales of goods imported from third territories or third countries and special arrangements for declaration and payment of import VAT
part_text:
The European Parliament approves a draft European Union law on value added tax (VAT) for online sales of imported goods. The law makes online sellers and platforms responsible for paying VAT on imported goods when they do not use the single import window, a simplified system for declaring and paying this tax. The Parliament accepts the Council's text without changes. This is an opinion in a consultation, so the Council decides.

- Sellers and platforms selling imported goods to buyers in the European Union must pay import VAT if they skip the single import window.
- The single import window stays voluntary, not mandatory as first proposed.
- The Council will now decide; the Parliament asks to be told if the text changes substantially.
